{
 "summary": "Enables the `-Wunused-const-variable` compiler warning in CMake. To prevent header-defined constants from triggering unused variable warnings in translation units where they are not referenced, the PR updates constants across Bitcoin Core and embedded subtrees to `inline constexpr`.",
 "problem": "The build system does not check for unused const variables because header-defined constants with internal linkage trigger unused variable diagnostics whenever an include does not use them.",
 "card": "Enables the `-Wunused-const-variable` compiler warning in CMake and updates header-defined constants across the codebase and subtree libraries to `inline constexpr`. Without this, headers declaring constants with internal linkage cause build failures when included in translation units that do not use them. The change is split out of an effort to enable `-Wunused` (#36167) and depends on upstream subtree PRs in LevelDB, Minisketch, and CRC32C.",
 "dependencies": {
  "depends_on": [
   "https://github.com/bitcoin-core/leveldb-subtree/pull/65",
   "https://github.com/bitcoin-core/minisketch/pull/105",
   "https://github.com/bitcoin-core/crc32c-subtree/pull/10"
  ],
  "enables": [
   "#36167"
  ]
 }
}
